import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    x1 = next(it)
    x2 = next(it)

    arr = []
    for _ in range(n):
        a = next(it)
        b = next(it)
        left = a * x1 + b
        right = a * x2 + b
        arr.append((left, -right, right))

    arr.sort()

    values = sorted(set(r for _, _, r in arr))
    rank = {v: i + 1 for i, v in enumerate(values)}
    m = len(values)

    bit = [0] * (m + 1)
    ans = 0
    processed = 0

    for _, _, r in arr:
        idx = rank[r]

        s = 0
        j = idx - 1
        while j > 0:
            s += bit[j]
            j -= j & -j

        ans += processed - s

        j = idx
        while j <= m:
            bit[j] += 1
            j += j & -j

        processed += 1

    sys.stdout.write(str(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
